channel.title: Global Africa Network Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Global Africa Network Media (globalafricanetwork.com)

item.title: Gauteng: Africa’s mining innovation capital
item.description: Join investors, OEMs, buyers and technology leaders as the GGDA unlocks high-impact opportunities across African mining value chains, Wednesday, 11 February 2026 at the Mining Indaba, CTICC 1, Level 1.

item.title: Africa Energy Indaba announces opening plenary panel on “Energy Access and Energy Poverty – Mission 300M”
item.description: The Opening Plenary will serve as the flagship session launching three days of strategic dialogue, investment engagement and project development discussions.

item.title: Infrastructure Africa 2026 opens with high-level plenary on ‘Building the Backbone for AfCFTA Success’
item.description: The session will explore how infrastructure investment across transport, energy and ICT sectors can reduce trade barriers, lower transaction costs and enhance regional competitiveness under the AfCFTA framework.

item.title: Seeking funding partners for apple juice concentrate plant
item.description: Seeking investors for the production of apple juice concentrate. The project is currently being developed.

item.title: Special Economic Zones in South Africa
item.description: SEZs are located in areas with particular resources and historical sectoral strengths. The relevant SEZs are geared to serve, support and encourage development of those resources and sectors across South Africa.

item.title: Cyber Security Summit – South Africa 2026
item.description: The summit will convene 200+ C-level executives, CISOs, cybersecurity leaders, and technology decision-makers to exchange insights on protecting digital ecosystems while enabling innovation and growth.

item.title: Digital Transformation Summit – South Africa 2026
item.description: Bringing together 200+ C-level executives, CIOs, CTOs, technology leaders, policymakers, and digital decision-makers, the summit is set to take place on 11th March 2026 at the Indaba Hotel, Spa and Conference Centre.

item.title: ELIDZ expands digital and advanced manufacturing skills development across the Eastern Cape
item.description: Through practical, hands-on training workshops delivered in partnership with key stakeholders, including technology partners and training institutions, ELIDZ STP is equipping participants with industry-relevant skills that enhance employability, support entrepreneurship, and enable meaningful participation in the digital economy.

item.title: Investment support outreach strengthens collaboration between private and public sector
item.description: The Investment Support Outreach contributes to building a credible provincial investment pipeline, translating national support instruments into tangible impact, job creation, and sustainable industrial growth in the Eastern Cape.

item.title: A regional overview of business and investment in KwaZulu-Natal
item.description: By John Young One of the most important decisions of 2025 regarding the economy of KwaZulu-Natal took place in the Durban High Court where a ruling was made against an attempt to block an agreement for a private operator to run Durban Container Terminal 2.
